overview.description: In seeking to achieve its investment objective, the Trust holds Portfolio Crypto Assets and accrues the Sponsor’s management fee in U.S. dollars. The Trust rebalances monthly alongside the rebalance of the index to stay current with changes. The Sponsor strives to minimize tracking error by managing costs and price slippage during trade execution and holding the assets in the index.
